headlines.title_en: Wallstreetcn Breakfast | September 11, 2026
headlines.summary_en: The S&P 500 fell for a fourth straight day, with memory chip stocks broadly lower; US Treasury yields surged; US crude oil soared 7% to break above $100; spot gold fell nearly 2%, approaching the $4,300 mark, while silver dropped more than 5%. The US Treasury's over $5 billion long-bond buyback fell short of its maximum target, failing to stem the Treasury selloff, with the 10-year yield approaching 5%. US August PPI posted its largest month-on-month gain in three months, and markets are pricing in a roughly 70% probability that the Federal Reserve will hike rates next week. The ECB raised rates for the second time this year, with reports saying it could act again as soon as October. The "Financial Powerhouse Construction" 15th Five-Year Plan was officially introduced, and the CSRC said it will further broaden medium- and long-term funding sources, channels and market entry methods, and make every effort to maintain the stable operation of the capital market. China's Ministry of Commerce: China and US economic and trade teams are negotiating a framework arrangement for reciprocal tariff cuts of $30 billion, striving for early implementation.

headlines.title: 观察人士称干预美债似乎与沃什的表态背道而驰，贝森特本人回应
headlines.summary: 美国财长贝森特对一些观察人士的观点提出了异议，这些人指出他干预美债市场的举动似乎与美联储主席沃什“让市场自由定价，不受央行指导”的表态不一致。沃什曾在7月份表示：“市场参与者正在学会打‘球’（关注基本面），而不是盯着‘裁判’（美联储）。” 贝森特表示，批评人士“想要营造出一种斯科特·贝森特与凯文·沃什对立的局面”，并称这种说法“纯属无稽之谈”。贝森特说，“投资者并没有对长期美国债务要求更高的风险溢价”，并将相关担忧形容为“一堆噪音”。

headlines.title_en: Observers say intervention in US Treasuries appears to run counter to Warsh's remarks, Bessent himself responds
headlines.summary_en: US Treasury Secretary Bessent pushed back on the views of some observers who noted that his intervention in the US Treasury market appeared inconsistent with Federal Reserve Chairman Warsh's statement of "letting markets price freely, without central bank guidance." Warsh said in July: "Market participants are learning to play the 'ball' (focus on fundamentals), rather than staring at the 'referee' (the Fed)." Bessent said critics "want to create a situation of Scott Bessent versus Kevin Warsh," and called such claims "pure nonsense." Bessent said, "Investors are not demanding a higher risk premium on long-term US debt," and described related concerns as "a bunch of noise."

headlines.title: 工信部印发《“人工智能+软件”专项行动实施方案》
headlines.summary: 工业和信息化部近日印发《“人工智能+软件”专项行动实施方案》。《方案》提出，到2028年，软件和信息技术服务业智能化水平显著提升，培育一批高水平智能编程工具和智能开发平台，推广应用覆盖2万家规模以上软件企业，关键软件智能化升级取得显著成效，累计组织实施100项软件企业智能化技改项目，以智能体软件为代表的软件新形态加速涌现，在重点行业打造100个智能体软件标杆应用，信息技术服务向智能化、价值化跃升，形成一批行业深度应用解决方案和典型场景，开放协同的开源社区建设取得积极进展，孵化5个以上优质开源项目。

headlines.title_en: MIIT issues the Implementation Plan for the "AI + Software" Special Action
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology recently issued the "AI + Software" Special Action Implementation Plan. The Plan proposes that by 2028, the intelligence level of the software and information technology services industry will be significantly improved, a batch of high-level intelligent programming tools and intelligent development platforms will be cultivated, and their promotion and application will cover 20,000 software enterprises above designated size. Intelligent upgrading of key software will achieve notable results, with a total of 100 intelligent technical transformation projects for software enterprises organized and implemented. New forms of software represented by agent software will emerge at an accelerated pace, with 100 benchmark applications of agent software built in key industries. Information technology services will leap toward intelligence and value, forming a batch of deeply industry-applied solutions and typical scenarios. Positive progress will be made in building an open and collaborative open source community, incubating more than 5 high-quality open source projects.
